summary: The repeat of the forgotten-added-voter experiment (receipt ec2c61af79bd42d7a5fe00657b7aeb22) reproduced identical values and all four outcomes — the restarted leader with three servers while the other nodes have four (violated, witness 1), the write applied at index 8 with C at 7 and D at 6 so only two of four committed voters hold it (violated, witness 3), and the controls keeping four voters (index 5) and refusing the same write under the committed membership (index 7). The child interpretation now cites both executions, records the repeat as counterevidence against a timing explanation, and drops the pending-repeat limitation, so all three consequence directions of the root cause (dropped voter via configuration change, resurrected removed voter, understated quorum from a forgotten added voter) plus the truncation and FSM-divergence safety violation now rest on retained, reproducible, control-backed comparisons.
